chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“The boundary of ʿArafah is from the interior of ʿUranah, Thawiyyah, Namirah, and Dhī al-Majāz, and behind the mountain is a standing place up to beyond the mountain.”

key_terms.بَطْنِ عُرَنَةَ: the interior or valley area of ʿUranah mentioned as part of the boundary description
key_terms.ثَوِيَّةَ: Thawiyyah, a named place within the boundary markers
key_terms.حَدُّ: the boundary or legal limit being defined
key_terms.ذِي الْمَجَازِ: Dhī al-Majāz, a named place used as a boundary marker
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: ʿArafah, the sacred location of standing during hajj
key_terms.مَوْقِفٌ: a standing place, referring to the ritual station for hajj
key_terms.نَمِرَةَ: Namirah, a known location associated with ʿArafah

ai.seo_question: What are the boundaries of ʿArafah for the hajj standing rite?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the legal boundaries of ʿArafah and identifies the area valid for standing during hajj. Its significance lies in clarifying the sacred limits of the mawqif, which is essential for the correct performance of the rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The boundary of Arafat includes the Valley of 'Uranah, Thuwiyyah, Namirah, and Dhi al-Majaz, and extends behind the mountain to its rear."
